description: Price changes matched on domain, plan name, billing period and billing mode. Every row carries evidence_level: L1 = a person reopened the vendor's pricing page and checked the old and new price by hand; L2 = both dates' page snapshots contain the price, machine-checked and not yet human-confirmed. Rows that pass neither are hidden unless include_unverified is set. Rows with kind "renamed" record a plan name change, not a price change: their price fields are equal and pct is null. That two-basis split exists because most scraped "price changes" turn out to be annual-vs-monthly or a tier being withdrawn; see the basis field in each response.

include_unverified.description: Also return rows with no L1/L2 evidence (marked evidence_level=unverified)

since.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to last 90 days

name: price_changes
